title: iRacing Super Late Model: Learn to Drive Concord for iRacing Season 1 Week 4 Official Series

corners.braking: Heavy under braking to get the car slowed down and get it to rotate.
corners.line: Drive left side tires close to yellow line, turn in, roll center, throttle up past center.
corners.mistakes: Throttle up too soon, spin out or plow up track.

corners.label: T2
corners.line: Get car low in dog leg, run to pitch towards wall.
corners.exit: 50-60% throttle, maybe more, ride throttle the entire way.

corners.label: T3
corners.exit: throttle up and drive off corner

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: Lift out early, take a wider arc
corners.exit: Drive right underneath them on exit
corners.mistakes: Sending it down on the bottom, diving in
screwing up turn one can be made up

corners.label: T3

general_tips: Get heat in the tires for better grip.
Expect a super slick track at 100+ degrees.
Go high in turn 3 for a strong run down the front stretch.
Check your speed at the start finish line.
get car slowed up to drive out of corner fast
Turn three is key to every lap, backing it up gains time
aggressive throttle use can be beneficial
